red_intents.direct_strike: concentrated attack on the protected asset
red_intents.split_saturation: multi-axis asset attack that overloads one defensive sector
red_intents.decoy_flank: one aircraft pulls defenders while a delayed striker attacks the asset
red_intents.defender_attrition: neutralize a defender before transitioning to the asset

blue_responses.close_escort: both defenders maintain a compact asset-centered screen
blue_responses.forward_intercept: both defenders commit early against the leading threat
blue_responses.split_screen: defenders divide lateral sectors and independently intercept
blue_responses.reserve_counter: one defender pressures while one remains as an asset-side reserve

information_boundary.response_decision: select one frozen team response at decision_step from the legal history prefix

outcome_definition.success: protected asset reaches the defended exit corridor alive
outcome_definition.failure: protected asset is neutralized or exits the safety corridor

z1.question: does the pre-decision red trajectory depend on the blue pre-decision interaction policy

z3.question: is the response library complementary rather than dominated

stop_rule: If any of Z1, Z2, or Z3 fails, close CIRU after this single task-redesign attempt; do not tune gates or start learning.
